description: Test suite for the TermsOfService store in Mattermost, including functions to test saving, retrieving latest, and retrieving specific TermsOfService entries.

methods.name: TestTermsOfServiceStore
methods.description: Main test function that runs subtests for saving, fetching latest, and fetching specific TermsOfService.

methods.name: cleanUpTOS
methods.description: Clears the TermsOfService table before each test to ensure test isolation.

methods.name: testSaveTermsOfService
methods.description: Tests saving a TermsOfService entry and verifies ID and creation timestamp are populated.

methods.name: testGetLatestTermsOfService
methods.description: Tests retrieving the latest TermsOfService and verifies its content and user association.

methods.name: testGetTermsOfService
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific TermsOfService by ID, including error handling for invalid IDs.
